summary: Husqvarna publishes bar and chain combination tables — its annual Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide and operator manuals list bar length, pitch, gauge, chain type and drive-link count per model. Its chain codes — H30, SP33G and C33 X-Cut for .325″, H80, S83G and C83 X-Cut for 3/8″, H37, S93G and H38 for 3/8″ low profile — are the cross-reference keys on every Husqvarna page here.
